heading.text: Your sessions: each one is its own mine and its own save.
Delete Session 1? Its mine, money, upgrades, rebirths and drills are gone for good.
Delete Session 2? Its mine, money, upgrades, rebirths and drills are gone for good.

Mine the vein in the north wall, or ride the lift at the end of the tunnel into the caves: your light is the timer, die down there and you lose that haul. Sell chunks at the Ore Trader (east stall), or refine them in the machines (landing, west side): bars and cut gems are worth far more. Spend money + bars at the workshop (landing, east side) on a better pick, lantern, backpack, deeper caves and drills. The tablet always shows your next goal.
Rebirth? Money, pick, lantern, backpack, caves, drills and machines of this session reset. Everything sells for more, for good.
Give up? The lift pulls you home and everything you mined on this run is lost.
